# Create Product Images with AI

**Languages:** [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README_zh.md)

Prepare product scenes, clean images, editable promotions, and consistent displays through five practical AI tasks.

[Start this course on AILesson](https://ailesson.io/courses/create-product-images-with-ai)

You have product photos to work with: a cluttered background to clean, a social post to illustrate, or a different-sized space to fill. AI can help prepare those images. You still need to decide what to change, keep the product recognizable and check the file you will use.

These five guided tasks cover a product scene, a clean product image, an editable message graphic, a new image shape and a consistent pair of product images. Each Lesson supplies its own practice material and completes its own task. Follow the suggested order or choose the task you need; no Lesson requires an image you made in another one.

You will assemble requests, inspect actual recorded results, and decide what to accept or revise. Save the images, editable files where relevant, and worksheets to help start a similar task of your own. The practice uses supplied choices and recorded AI results; it does not upload your photos or generate a live image.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I need a real product photo to begin?

No. Each Lesson supplies clearly identified AI-generated practice photos. For your own product, start with clear photos you are allowed to use and compare every edited result with those originals.

### Do I need a paid image tool?

You can complete the guided practice without an external image tool. To repeat the photo tasks, use a tool that supports image uploads and editing; for editable text layouts, use one that can create an SVG file and a preview. Access requirements depend on the service you choose.

### Can I use the result as a shop listing image?

The practice result is for a teaching product, not an actual item for sale. For a real listing, check the edited image against your product and the destination's current image requirements before publishing. Course completion does not perform that check for you.
